cases.question: A prospect wants to stop by the Miami studio before deciding. Can I arrange an informal pop-in?
cases.goldAnswer: No. Do not arrange an unplanned studio visit outside the person's filming date. Send the approved virtual studio walkthrough instead.

cases.question: A Call 1 applicant sent an aggressive, profane reply and their application suggests a criminal background. Should I still let them into the Zoom?
cases.goldAnswer: No. Tell the applicant they are not a fit and the company will not move forward, and do not admit them to the Zoom.

cases.question: I booked a lead from the 20% spreadsheet, but Keap currently lists Rudy as the rep. Should I change the owner to myself?
cases.goldAnswer: Yes. If you booked the available 20% lead, update the Keap owner from Rudy to yourself.
requiredConcepts: to the rep who booked the lead

cases.question: How many leads may I take from the 20% spreadsheet and the 20% dial-out channel?
cases.goldAnswer: The limit is 20 from the spreadsheet and 20 from the channel.

cases.question: Can a client use a debit card through the credit-card payment link?
cases.goldAnswer: Yes. The credit-card payment link also accepts a debit card.

cases.question: A lead is sending repeated inappropriate messages after leaving a Zoom. What should I do?
cases.goldAnswer: Block the lead in Zoom, opt them out, and report the case in Sales Tech so future contact can be blocked or unsubscribed.

cases.question: A signed ACH payment failed because the client's bank account was temporarily restricted after a name change. Can they update the payment method and keep the signed Lite terms?
cases.goldAnswer: Yes, but obtain hard proof from the bank and complete the corrected payment before that Sunday's deadline.

cases.question: May I schedule a Call 2 or a reschedule at 6:30 or 7 PM on my personal calendar?
cases.goldAnswer: Yes. Set your public or personal calendar to the hours you want, but do not overlap it with or modify the master calendar.

cases.question: Should I tell a prospect that ISTV completes a formal full background check before approval?
cases.goldAnswer: No. Describe it as a background review using social profiles, Google searches, and similar checks, not as a formal full background check.
requiredConcepts: not a formal full background check

cases.question: Can a franchise owner proceed, or do they need approval from the ultimate brand decision-maker?
cases.goldAnswer: They can proceed, but they will probably need approval from the brand or ultimate decision-maker.
forbiddenConcepts: franchise owner always has unrestricted authority

cases.question: I took a call from the pass-off channel and need the recording for greenlight review. Where should I get it?
cases.goldAnswer: For a pass-off call, ask the rep who originally owned the call to DM you the recording. Dummy-channel recordings are available in that channel.
forbiddenConcepts: recording is always in pass-off channel

cases.question: Keap's disposition form does not list the show the lead applied for. Should I just select Legacy Makers?
cases.goldAnswer: Do not guess the show. Report the missing show option in Sales Tech so the form can be corrected.

cases.question: A prospect no-showed Call 1 and never completed the first audition, but contacted me the following week to reschedule. Must they wait 90 days?
cases.goldAnswer: No. Because the first audition was never conducted, you may reschedule them the following week.

cases.question: Does a physical therapist who owns three practices qualify for America's Best Doctors?
cases.goldAnswer: Yes. A physical therapist with three owned practices can qualify for America's Best Doctors.

cases.question: A business-owner couple wants to discuss one partner's childhood abuse and how she overcame it to help others. Is that story itself unsuitable for the show?
cases.goldAnswer: No. That story can be suitable when discussed openly to help others; continue the normal fit and greenlight process.
forbiddenConcepts: automatic disqualification because the topic is sensitive

cases.question: A cast member's own videographer cancelled just before filming. Can you tell me which replacement videographer to hire?
cases.goldAnswer: The chatbot should not choose a live vendor. Ask in the Fulfillment channel for the current approved referral or next step.

cases.question: A prospect completed Call 1 for both a Daymond John show and an ISTV show with different reps. Which rep should continue?
cases.goldAnswer: The rep who conducted the first Call 1 or held the first booking should continue, and the second rep should cancel. A non-DJ rep must not sell the DJ offer.
requiredConcepts: first Call 1 or booking keeps lead
forbiddenConcepts: either rep may sell either offer

cases.question: A woman works full time but runs paid book collaborations and wants to expand beyond her region. Could she be a fit for America's Authors?
cases.goldAnswer: Yes. That can be a fit for America's Authors, and she may also benefit from networking at the Mastermind event.

prompts.question: A prospect says their attorney must review the contract before payment. What should I do first?
prompts.goldAnswer: First walk the prospect through the contract and resolve their questions live on the call.

prompts.question: What if they still insist on having the attorney look at it?
prompts.goldAnswer: As a last resort, send the approved contract PDF and schedule another call to continue the close.

prompts.question: What is the difference between Call 1, Call 2, and onboarding?
prompts.goldAnswer: Call 1 is the first audition. Call 2 is the closing call. Onboarding happens after payment and contract signing to prepare the client for production.

prompts.question: Who handles that last stage, and when should it be booked?
prompts.goldAnswer: The studio team handles onboarding. Book it for the day after the close using the instructions in the welcome email.

prompts.question: How are the 100,000 guaranteed promotional views delivered and tracked?
prompts.goldAnswer: They are delivered through a Facebook ad run from the official ISTV Instagram page, and the client receives dashboard access to track the campaign.
requiredConcepts: Facebook ad through official ISTV Instagram

prompts.question: Can the client choose the audience and how long it takes to reach the view target?
prompts.goldAnswer: Targeting is configured from the ad copy, creative text, and relevant location. Do not promise a delivery timeline; timing is a post-sale Fulfillment question.
requiredConcepts: targeting based on copy and location
forbiddenConcepts: client can freely select any audience
guarantee a few weeks or two months
